hook: A new AI chip promises twice the inference speed at half the power.
key_points: The Helios-A1 targets on-device inference for phones and edge devices.
Vendor claims 2x tokens-per-second versus the previous generation.
Power draw is rated at 5 watts, enabling all-day battery life.
First devices with the chip are expected later this year.
